body: By adding a check to non finite values in the `connectRange` connector, a bug was highlighted inside the starRating widget. createURL function was called with the following format {lowerbound, max}, instead of {min, max}.

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @vvo, @bobylito and @Morhaus to be potential reviewers

title: fix(starRating): call createURL with the right interface (min/max)
